source: NCR Consumer Credit Market Report, March 2017 (2017-Q1), Appendix D Tables 21 and 23
basis: ACCOUNTS, not rand value, and not households

model_target.note: Baseline (no-BNPL) target for D6/D7. Combined unsecured + credit facilities is the closest analogue to the model's consolidated D_trad for an LMI household.

caveats: CCMR counts ACCOUNTS; the model counts HOUSEHOLDS. A household may hold several accounts, so account-level arrears rates are not directly a household-level default rate. Treat as an order-of-magnitude target and state the unit mismatch.

Section 4.4 of the converted markdown has a CORRUPT '% Number of accounts' column for credit facilities (83.22% repeated for all 13 quarters). Appendix D Table 21 is authoritative and reproduces the report's prose figure of 71.55%.
The model's tick is 14 days, so default at k ticks does not align with CCMR day buckets unless k=7 (98 days), which is the first tick boundary at or beyond the 90-day convention.
